divergence_justification: The 197,931 only-oracle rows are the independently counted hospital POE/detail branch selected by General Care/Code status. The served FHIR warehouse has no resource/path carrying those POE events, poe_detail.field_value, or poe.ordertime. MedicationRequest's medication-request-poe identifier stream is a different medication/IV/TPN subset and was tested and rejected. The Observation chart branch is fully represented, and attempt 0002 completed Observation.id UUID-witness recovery for all nine prior timestamp substitutions, leaving 71,141 exact chart tuples and no candidate residual. No divergent dependencies exist.
